text:
ravi: opened a small PR that updates the JS SDK snippet in the migration guide and fixes two broken links. preview build failed on one external link redirect. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

elaine: thanks. are examples covered by CODEOWNERS? we keep getting unassigned examples PRs.

bot-lint: docs-preview: FAILED 
Reason: external redirect blocked for https://old-hosting.example.com/snippet.js (render error)

kevin: examples are not currently in CODEOWNERS, only /docs/** is. i'd +1 adding /examples/** -> @redwood/docs.

ravi: main ask: can tiny docs-only fixes be merged automatically? link fixes and snippet corrections are noisy.

elaine: i'd be ok with auto-merge if: 1) PR only touches docs/ or examples/ 2) required checks pass (docs-preview, linkcheck, md-lint) 3) label `docs:ready` is present 4) PR does not touch CODEOWNERS or any infra files.

kevin: automation caveats: exclude any paths with "private/" or filenames like ".env" or "credentials". also skip auto-merge when release freeze active.

ops-bot: release-freeze window check: next freeze starts 2026-03-28T16:00:00Z. currently outside freeze.

ravi: i fixed the redirect by replacing external asset with an inline snippet. re-pushed, re-run checks.

bot-lint: docs-preview: PASSED 
linkcheck: PASSED 
md-lint: PASSED

elaine: once CODEOWNERS change lands to include examples, i'll add the `docs:ready` label and a human reviewer will glance and then we can let the action merge.

kevin: sample workflow idea: require label, run blocklist script, verify not modifying CODEOWNERS, confirm no private paths, check freeze via ops-bot API, then call merge with squash. post a comment with the merge SHA and actor.

ravi: perfect. i'll open a tiny CODEOWNERS PR to add /examples/** to @redwood/docs and then request the label after it's merged.

ops-bot: note: changes to CODEOWNERS will request reviews from teams listed and may delay auto-merge until approval.

elaine: quick action list: kevin write the GH action, ravi open CODEOWNERS PR, i'll be the human gate for initial rollouts.

kevin: on it. i'll also add a safety check to block auto-merge if PR touches any file containing the string "PRIVATE_KEY".

ravi: thanks everyone, pinging when CODEOWNERS PR is ready.
